title: The recording tableaux in the quantum Littlewood-Richardson map, the orthogonal transpose symmetry map, and the computation of $\mathfrak{k}$-highest weight tableaux
summary: Recently Watanabe has given an algorithm to compute a bijection, that he calls (quantum) Littlewood-Richardson (LR) map of type AII, between semi-standard Young tableaux of shape a partition with at most $2n$ parts and pairs of tableaux consisting of a symplectic tableau with shape a partition with at most $n$ parts, and a recording tableau of skew-shape given by the two previous shapes. The recording tableaux in that algorithm are shown to be equinumerous to LR-Sundaram tableaux whose injectivity is shown combinatorially while the surjectivity is concluded via representation theory of a…
